card.name: The word to after hypersensitivity
card.fires_on: The word "to" right after "hypersensitivity", "hypersensitive" or "sensitivity", mostly in contraindication statements. It comes just before the named drug or ingredient.

modes.label: Contraindication wording
modes.description: "to" after known sensitivity or hypersensitivity in a contraindications section.
modes.example: CONTRAINDICATIONS Lorazepam Injection is contraindicated in patients with a known sensitivity<< to>> benzodiazepines or its vehicle
